text:
maria_ae: Heads up — during the live Acme demo we started seeing lots of 5xx/503s around 10:12PT. Attendees reported failed responses. Pinging @olivia_oncall and @josh_se, need triage now.

olivia_oncall: On it. Can you paste a failing request id and a short log snippet?

maria_ae: Quick dump from the attendee machine (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
< HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
< x-request-id: req_abc123
< x-error-code: capacity_throttle
{"error":"service overloaded: throttle, queue_len=124"}
```

maria_ae: Other failing ids: req_abc124, req_abc125 — demo is paused.

ops-bot: [autoscaler] detected sustained queue > 80 for pool 'burstpool-us-west2' — scaling requested (delta=2). Estimated node ready time ~35s.

josh_se: Sounds like burst pool exhaustion + autoscale cold-start lag. Likely concurrent-request cap hit for that org. Two quick options: failover to smaller model or route to a dedicated demo pool.

kevin_sre: I can confirm spike in per-customer concurrency for acme_demo_org. Per-customer concurrency limit hit, not global rate-limit. We can temporarily raise the org concurrency or route to dedicated-demo-1. Also seeing longer model init times for quantized variant.

sean_support: If you post the request ids I'll correlate with infra logs and get the exact error traces. Meanwhile recommend client-side retries with exp backoff (retry after 500ms -> 1s -> 2s).

maria_ae: Request ids posted above. Attendees reported blank output + spinner. We're losing demo momentum.

ops-bot: [deployment] autoscaler action: burstpool-us-west2 4 -> 6 (2 nodes requested). Health checks: 0/2 ready (starting).

josh_se: Temporary mitigation I suggest: switch client to 'small-llama' model and reduce max_tokens to 256 so requests land on smaller instances and have faster startup. Can someone flip a route?

kevin_sre: I pushed a route to dedicated-demo-1 pointing at small-llama and increased acme_demo_org concurrency to 50 for the next 45 minutes. Also pre-warmed 1 instance.

maria_ae: Switched endpoint on the client side to the dedicated-demo-1 target — test request now returns 200 and text. Demo resumed. :tada:

olivia_oncall: Follow-up actions: create ticket to track root cause and reduce autoscale cold-start impact. I created INF-5421 (eng-runtime) to investigate warm pool and pre-warm playbook for scheduled demos.

sean_support: Confirmed INF-5421 created and attached req ids req_abc123/124/125 + infra traces. Assigned to kevin_sre and eng-runtime triage.

maria_ae: Thanks everyone — demo finished with the workaround. I'll share a short postmortem with Acme and request dedicated pre-warm next time. Closing thread after notes. :white_check_mark:
